- concat > weighted (moderate, 1-3% difference)

3. The only untested RNA encoder in this optimal setup is scvi_n200

I'll go with config_049: scvi_n200, imagenet_vit_l, avgpool, concat. This tests whether a learned RNA encoder (scvi_n200) can match or beat PCA in the best aggregation/fusion/image setup.
